mapper.select: select c.id, c.product_id, c.sku_id, c.quantity, c.checked, p.name as productName,p.main_image as mainImage,p.status as productStatus,p.deleted as productDeleted, s.specs as skuSpecs,s.image as skuImage,s.price,s.stock,s.status as skuStatus,s.deleted as skuDeleted from cart_item c left join product p on c.product_id = p.id left join product_sku s on c.sku_id = s.id where c.user_id = #{userId} order by c.create_time desc

select c.id from cart_item c left join product_sku s on c.sku_id = s.id left join product p on c.product_id = p.id where p.status = 1 and s.status = 1 and p.deleted = 0 and s.deleted = 0 and s.stock >= c.quantity

SELECT c.id, c.product_id, c.sku_id, c.quantity, p.merchant_id, p.name AS productName, p.main_image AS mainImage, s.specs AS skuSpecs, s.price, s.stock, s.status AS skuStatus, s.deleted AS skuDeleted, p.status AS productStatus, p.deleted AS productDeleted FROM cart_item c INNER JOIN product p ON c.product_id = p.id INNER JOIN product_sku s ON c.sku_id = s.id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.checked = 1
